Description
: Enhance your collectibles display or pipe collection with this vintage Trend Clocks wooden pipe rack and glass tobacco humidor. The sturdy wooden frame by Trend Clocks (Holland, Michigan) holds up to 6 pipes and features a glass humidor jar with a secure wooden lid, ideal for keeping pipe tobacco fresh. This listing includes 7assorted estate pipes in various conditions and designs, plus two vintage boxes of pipe filters visible inside the jar. Its classic wood grain and retro design add timeless appeal, making it suitable for both use and decorative display. Each pipe slot is crafted for easy organization, while the center jar keeps your accessories handy. Signs of age and use, such as surface dust and char marks, are visible, but the structure remains durable and well-crafted. A practical and attractive piece for tobacco enthusiasts, estate pipe collectors, or vintage home decor lovers
